# code-issue (alias)

`code-issue` is the former name of `implement-issue`. Invoke `sectile:implement-issue` with the same arguments (in Claude Code, the Skill tool). If the running agent cannot invoke skills, read the sibling `../implement-issue/SKILL.md` and follow it as written.
